title: Assistente administrativo - (financeiro)
description:
Confira a vaga para Assistente administrativo - (financeiro) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre o Instituto Somos uma ONG que tem como propósito impulsionar a transformação da educação por meio da conectividade. Nossa missão é levar internet de alta velocidade gratuita para escolas públicas do Brasil! Sobre o cargo: Você atuará no apoio às rotinas financeiras do Instituto Redes do Futuro, com foco em Fluxo de Caixa e Tesouraria, contribuindo para a eficiência, transparência e sustentabilidade financeira das nossas ações de impacto social. Seu papel será fundamental para garantir a boa gestão dos recursos e apoiar o crescimento do Instituto. O que você irá fazer: - Controle do fluxo de caixa diário, mensal e anual; - Execução de rotinas de contas a pagar e a receber; - Conciliação bancária e acompanhamento de saldos e movimentações; - Apoio no controle financeiro dos recursos do Instituto; - Apoio na elaboração de relatórios financeiros periódicos; - Análise de variações financeiras e acompanhamento de resultados; - Organização de dados financeiros em planilhas e sistemas, garantindo clareza e confiabilidade; - Suporte aos processos contábeis, assegurando conformidade com normas fiscais e regulatórias, especialmente do terceiro setor; - Organização de documentos para auditorias internas, externas e prestação de contas; - Organização, manutenção e atualização de documentos financeiros, fiscais e administrativos; - Garantia de arquivamento seguro, integridade e fácil rastreabilidade das informações; - Apoio às rotinas administrativas da gestão; - Contato com fornecedores, quando necessário; - Suporte a outras áreas da instituição, contribuindo para o bom funcionamento geral; O que você precisa ter: - Ensino Médio completo ou Curso Técnico ou Superior em andamento ou completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Finanças ou áreas correlatas - Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras (contas a pagar, contas a receber e conciliação bancária) - Controle de fluxo de caixa - Excel intermediário (análise de dados e controles financeiros) - Organização de documentos financeiros - Conhecimento no pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e Power Point) ou ferramentas equivalentes Local de trabalho: Faria Lima/SP O que oferecemos: - Modelo de trabalho híbrido (1x por semana presencial) - Carga horária de 16 horas semanais - Remuneração de R$ 1.500,00 mensais - Auxílio alimentação e transporte de R$ 200,00 mensais - Contratação no modelo PJ

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher with advanced portuguese skills em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Analista de governança de dados sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de governança de dados sênior em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança? Na redspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações. Seu papel no time: Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos. Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas. Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências. Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres. Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo). Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.  O que você traz na bagagem (Requisitos): Sólida experiência em Catalogação de Dados , gestão de metadados e glossários. Domínio de processos de Data Quality (limpeza, padronização e monitoramento). SQL Avançado para Data Profiling e análise de inconsistências. Conhecimento profundo dos princípios do DAMA-DMBOK. Excelente capacidade de documentação técnica para diferentes públicos.  Diferenciais que valorizamos: Experiência com ferramentas de mercado (Apache Atlas, CKAN, Purview ou similares). Vivência em projetos com foco em LGPD e Privacy by Design. Conhecimento em arquitetura Lakehouse ou modelagem semântica. Inovação com IA: Interesse em usar IA Generativa para automatizar metadados e documentação. Experiência com dados do setor público ou ambiental (CAR, SIGEF, INCRA) será um baita diferencial!  Por que a redspark? Se você busca um ambiente que valoriza a maturidade técnica, a autonomia e que entende que a Governança é a chave para o futuro da IA, seu lugar é aqui. Pronto(a) para elevar o nível dos nossos dados?

title: Business development representative
description:
Nova oportunidade para Business development representative em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We Master Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets. Responsibilities: • Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives. • Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact. • Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals. • Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies. • Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform. • Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue. • Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems. • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies. Qualifications: • 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles. • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). • Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills. • Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously. • Experience using CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce). • Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation. • Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage. What We Offer: • Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives • Ongoing professional development and career growth • Collaborative and international work environment • Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems Job Type : Full-Time / Remote Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

title: Operations director
description:
Confira a vaga para Operations director em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director   Introduction:    Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:    $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:    Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:    University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Consultor de energia
description:
Empresa está contratando Consultor de energia em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Empresa O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Sobre a Função Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória. Responsabilidades Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução; Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia; Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos); Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos; Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico; Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.); Atuar na gestãode riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços); Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade; Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia; Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia; Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas; Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP); Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs.  Local de atuação São Paulo/ SP  Requisitos Graduação em Engenharia (Elétrica, Energia, Produção), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Energia, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas afins Conhecimento em Integração Segurança Conhecimento em Ferramentas da qualidade Conhecimento em SAP, Power BI Vivência com autoprodução e/ou cogeração Experiência com comercialização de energia e gestão de contratos livres e regulados Conhecimento técnico em Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro (ANEEL, CCEE, ONS). Modelos de precificação (Formação do PLD, contratos indexados) Ferramentas de análise de mercado e modelagem energética Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução  Diferenciais Inglês e Espanhol avançado Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução

description:
Empresa está contratando Operations director em são bernardo do campo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:   University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em fazenda rio grande. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature Co   Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em barretos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM. The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern. Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em bauru. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern. description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing ai agent builder em são caetano do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Especialista fiscal
description:

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em toledo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em joinville. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  EST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.  You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .  What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)  Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member

description:

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products.
