About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

description:

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps)  Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)  Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction. Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em presidente prudente. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Empresa está contratando Assistente administrativo em birigui. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O Agente de Registro é o profissional responsável por atuar no processo de emissão de certificados digitais, garantindo a validação, segurança e conformidade dos procedimentos exigidos pela legislação e pelas entidades certificadoras. Sua função principal é verificar a autenticidade dos documentos apresentados, realizar atendimentos presenciais ou remotos, além de coletar dados biométricos e emitir o certificado digital.  Descrição de Cargo:   Realizar atendimento presencial ao cliente na unidade da instituição, com data e hora previamente agendadas, garantindo um serviço personalizado e eficiente.  Realizar atendimento remoto via videoconferência, assegurando a mesma qualidade de suporte oferecida no atendimento presencial.  Realizar atendimento in loco, quando necessário, deslocando-se até o local do cliente para oferecer suporte presencial, conforme a demanda e necessidade do cliente.  Tirar dúvidas e prestar orientações detalhadas sobre a usabilidade do certificado digital, proporcionando uma experiência de uso clara e facilitada.  Realizar a conferência e verificar a autenticidade e veracidade dos documentos apresentados, assegurando que estejam em conformidade com as exigências legais e regulamentares.  Lançar os dados do cliente no sistema interno, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas e devidamente registradas, seguindo os padrões de segurança e confidencialidade.  Coletar a biometria facial e digital do cliente de forma online, utilizando ferramentas tecnológicas que assegurem a precisão e segurança dos dados biométricos.  Realizar a emissão do certificado digital, garantindo que todos os procedimentos tenham sido devidamente cumpridos, e que o cliente receba o certificado de forma rápida e segura.  Orientar o cliente sobre o processo de download (baixa) do certificado digital, explicando sua importância, prazos de validade, e as melhores práticas para mantê-lo seguro e acessível.  Realizar o atendimento e fornecer suporte contínuo aos clientes e contadores, utilizando todos os meios de comunicação oferecidos pela empresa, como telefone, e-mail, chat ou outros, garantindo a solução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados ao certificado digital  Viajar ocasionalmente para treinar novos colaboradores, compartilhar boas práticas e padrões operacionais, ou ate mesmo para cobrir férias e ausências em diferentes unidades ou na sede da instituição, conforme a necessidade de alocação. Sendo que esta alocação é diferente da sua alocação rotineira.    Salário:    R$ 2.043,39    Benefícios:   * Vale alimentação/refeição de R$ 28,00 ao dia;  * Vale Saúde no valor de R$ 320,00 no mês;  * Plano Odontológico Dental Uni Elite;  * Convênio com farmácia;  * Gympass;  * Subsídio dê duas sessões de psicoterapia no espaço Existir;  * Convênio com instituições de ensino;  * Campanhas de comemoração para os colaboradores.

SOBRE O GROUPE SEB: Nosso propósito é facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras. Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo. Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo. Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas. Identificou-se com nosso negócio e valores? Então venha contribuir e deixar sua marca na história da SEB! Missão: Assegurar a consolidação da relação comercial entre a empresa e seus clientes regionais, garantindo a maximização do faturamento e rentabilidade da empresa via aumento de distribuição numérica (médios e pequenos clientes), através da comercialização de produtos e do aproveitamento dos recursos disponíveis da estrutura de marketing e trade marketing. Principais Atividades: Assegurar o atingimento das metas estabelecidas pela empresa com foco nas atividades relacionadas à distribuição (numérica) dos nossos produtos; Assegurar a aplicação da política comercial definida, através de negociações adequadas, visando atingir os objetivos de retorno e volume de vendas estabelecidos pela empresa; Assegurar a implementação do mix (sortimento) sugerido pelo Trade Marketing; Elaborar planosde negócios observando as necessidades do cliente e da empresa; Efetuar a prospecção de novos clientes visando o aumento da distribuição numérica; Acompanhar o comportamento e a evolução do mercado identificando oportunidades de negócio; Realizar busca continua para aumento de sortimento nos clientes, a fim de gerar rentabilidade para empresa atendendo os requisitos da política comercial; Executar outrastarefas correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato. Queremos construir um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e diverso, onde todos possam prosperar e contribuir com seu melhor. Se identificou com a vaga? Aplique-se para esse desafio e venha fazer parte do nosso time! Junte-se ao Groupe SEB e cresça com a gente!

Is materiais para funcionários SEB, Spot e varejistas.  O que você precisa ter para fazer parte desse time: Cursando a partir do 2o ano de graduação, Administração Engenharias, Economia e áreas afins. Estudar no período noturno, com disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas/dia; Inglês Intermediário (diferencial); Formação prevista a partir de 06/2027; Conhecimentos básicos em Excel, Power Point e ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense).  O que você encontrará na SEB? Bolsa auxílio de acordo com o ano da graduação.  Para Cuidados com a sua saúde: Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar.  Para cuidados com o seu Bem- Estar: Canal de apoio CARE: Para você cuidar da sua saúde: Emocional, Social, Legal e Financeira. Para a sua alimentação, oferecemos: Vale Refeição; R$ 47,00 por dia! Vale Alimentação; R$ 330,00 por mês!  Para sua mobilidade, oferecemos: Vale transporte.  Outros Benefícios: Seguro de vida; Auxílio Home Office, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido; Acesso aos produtos da SEB com desconto.  Se identificou com a empresa e com o nosso desafio? Aplique-se para essa oportunidade!

Position Overview The Director, FP& A – People Costs is a critical strategic partner to the CHRO, responsible for driving financial rigor, transparency, and forward-looking insights across all People Costs globally. This role will lead analysis, planning, forecasting, and process excellence for People Costs, while partnering closely with HR Zone Leaders, Finance, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure costs are well-managed, benchmarked, and aligned with business priorities. This is an early-career Director role, ideal for a high-performing Senior Manager ready to step into a broader enterprise-level leadership position with significant visibility and impact. Key Responsibilities 1. Monthly People Cost Performance & Forecasting (Primary Accountability) Lead the monthly analysis of People Costs across all zones, including actuals vs. budget, trend analysis, and forward-looking forecasts. Partner closely with HR Zone Leaders to: Identify drivers of performance and variances. Surface risks and opportunities to return to or beat plan. Diagnose top People Cost issues and facilitate structured problem-solving discussions. Ensure clear ownership of actions and follow-through. Leverage Zero-Based Organization (ZBO) analysis and external benchmarks to: Assess performance versus standards and peers. Identify structural cost opportunities and productivity improvements. Synthesize insights into clear, compelling executive-level narratives, not just reports.  2. Lead the Global People Cost Budget & Planning Process Own and lead the end-to-end People Cost budget process, delivering a high-quality consolidated plan to Global FP& A. Establish and maintain: Budgeting templates. Planning assumptions and guidance. Analytical frameworks to ensure consistency and comparability across zones. Partner with HR and Finance leaders in each zone to ensure: Timely submission of plans. High-quality, well-reasoned inputs. Clear articulation of levers to achieve or exceed plan. Analyze the consolidated plan to identify: Key risks and opportunities. Cost levers and trade-offs. Scenarios to support decision-making.  3. Build and Implement a Scalable People Cost Management Process Design and implement a standardized, end-to-end People Cost management process, integrating: Budgeting Monthly results Forecasting Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate reporting and analysis. Partner cross-functionally with: Finance HR Zone Leaders Data Scientists / Analytics teams Drive adoption of new tools, dashboards, and ways of working that improve insight, speed, and decision quality.  4. Strategic Project Management (Approx. 25% of Role) Support the CHRO by project managing high-priority, non-People Cost initiatives, acting as a trusted thought partner and execution leader. Responsibilities may include: Structuring complex initiatives. Developing workplans, milestones, and tracking mechanisms. Driving cross-functional alignment and accountability. Preparing executive-level materials and updates. This aspect of the role provides exposure to enterprise-wide priorities and senior leadership.  Critical Capabilities & Skills Advanced data analytics and financial modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into insights. Strong problem-solving mindset; comfortable working through ambiguity and complexity. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, particularly in executive presentations. Ability to influence without authority and work effectively across geographies and functions. High learning agility, ownership mindset, and bias for action. Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed levels.  Experience & Profile 8–12 years of experience in FP& A, finance, strategy, or related analytical roles. Currently a Senior Manager or equivalent, ready for a first Director role. Experience partnering closely with senior leaders (HR or functional leadership exposure strongly preferred). Background in budgeting, forecasting, and performance management in a complex, multi-geography organization. Experience with ZBO, cost transformation, or productivity programs is a strong plus.  Why This Role High visibility and direct partnership with the CHRO. Opportunity to shape how People Costs are managed globally. Exposure to enterprise-level decision-making and transformation initiatives. Clear runway for growth and expanded leadership responsibility. You will be accountable for ensuring that each project meets its defined objectives and KPIs, proactively designing and executing strategies to drive performance, adoption, and partner satisfaction. In close collaboration with the Customer Service team, you will lead initiatives that enhance student engagement and deliver an exceptional service experience. As the main operational point of contact for partners, you will lead project execution, align cross-functional teams, anticipate risks, and identify opportunities for growth and renewal. Design and execute data-driven strategies to improve adoption, engagement, and overall project outcomes. Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead coordination across internal teams (Product, Operations, Content, Legal, etc.) to ensure alignment, timely execution, and successful delivery of project requirements and new initiatives. Process Optimization & Scalability: Continuously evaluate and improve workflows, tools, and processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and quality in project execution. Risk Management & Continuous Improvement: Anticipate potential challenges, identify root causes of issues, and implement proactive solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on insights, feedback, and performance trends. Reporting & Insights: Track, analyze, and report on key performance metrics, providing actionable insights to the account owner, partner stakeholders, and internal leadership to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments. Stakeholder & cross-functional collaboration: Experience working with multiple internal teams and supporting external stakeholders in coordination with an account owner or manager. Global & cross-cultural collaboration: Experience working in multicultural environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across regions, cultures, and time zones. Customer/student engagement focus: Experience driving adoption, engagement, or satisfaction in service-based or educational environments. Analytical & problem-solving skills: Ability to identify performance gaps and implement effective, data-driven solutions. Strong communication skills: Ability to clearly convey updates, insights, and recommendations to different audiences. G., Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana, Excel/Sheets). Background in Ed Tech or education programs: Experience managing or supporting educational initiatives, digital learning platforms, or student-focused services. title: Global compliance manager - bioenergy
description:
Empresa está contratando Global compliance manager - bioenergy em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Nufarm. Evolving Ag. Nufarm is a global crop protection and seed technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and fuel production. Whether it's commercialising the world's first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers. Your Future, Fuelled by Innovation The Global Compliance Lead, Bioenergy Assurance is responsible for the effective execution of Nufarm's global Assurance Program and related compliance systems. The role leads global certification and audit direction, works closely with regional teams to achieve and maintain 100% certification readiness and compliance, and broadens program oversight beyond certification to include legal, environmental, social, traceability, and internal policy requirements. This position also oversees internal assessment of centrally managed global processes - including GHG tool governance, methodology determination, risk management, and related controls - to identify gaps, drive corrective actions, and strengthen end-to-end assurance performance across the business. How You'll Help Us Grow Lead global certification and audit direction across the Assurance Program, including coordination with certification bodies, auditors, and regional teams. Monitor and collaborate with relevant global certification schemes to maintain Nufarm's leadership and competitive position. Own interpretation and implementation guidance for certification requirements, standards, procedures, and related external scheme updates. Drive certification readiness and performance across regions to achieve and maintain 100% certification compliance. Oversee certification program deployment and implementation for new countries, processors, value chain partners, and applicable carbon-credit or market requirements. Support and provide oversight across the internal audit program(s) for regional assurance activities, ensuring audits are completed well, correctly, and comprehensively. This role is not responsible for regional program implementation. Conduct internal assessment or audit of centrally managed global processes owned by the global team, potentially including GHG tool modelling and development, methodology determination, documentation controls, and risk management processes. Identify control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance risks across legal, environmental, social, and internal requirements. Verify that centrally managed processes are documented, version-controlled, implemented consistently, and supported by appropriate evidence. Facilitate or oversee risk identification, risk assessment, risk management, and risk monitoring activities required under the Assurance Program and associated standards. Contribute to updates to global certification documentation, audit tools, SOPs, work instructions, and related compliance materials. Partner with program management, data/IT, and regional teams to strengthen systems, reporting, and process design for ongoing program improvement. Review regional audit outputs, supporting evidence, and corrective action plans; escalate and ensure closure of significant non-compliances as appropriate. Monitor regional execution of land use verification, traceability, mass balance, UDB-related direction, training, and documentation expectations. Assess regional capability and provide coaching, training, and tools to improve audit quality and consistency. Build trusted working relationships across regions and functions to align expectations, remove barriers, and reinforce accountability. Provide leadership, mentoring, and development for any direct reports and strong matrix leadership for regional assurance personnel. Support training, communication, and change management efforts related to certification, compliance, and assurance.  If you want to be a part of a thriving, supportive environment and are inspired by the prospect of being a part of something bigger, we'd love to hear from you. Nufarm is proud to be recognised as an endorsed top 10 employer of choice for all women by WORK180. A note to recruitment agencies - we have this role covered. There is no need to get in touch, we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Empresa está contratando Investment banking intern em camboriú. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em toledo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em itupeva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em jaguariúna. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Do you enjoy working inside systems, fixing what’s broken, and making things run correctly?  Can you take messy, inconsistent data and turn it into something accurate, reliable, and usable?   Do you get satisfaction from building workflows, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks?   Final question:  When faced with a complex challenge, do you get excited, or run away?  At Crisp, we’re on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.  We operate with the intensity of a championship team, where every player is expected to bring their best, own their outcomes, and drive results.  We’re hiring a Hub Spot Sales Data Operations team member to support our Sales organization by owning data accuracy, workflow execution, and system reliability inside Hub Spot.  This role exists for one reason:  …to ensure that our Hub Spot data is accurate, our sales workflows function correctly, and our Sales team can operate without friction, enabling leadership to make decisions based on reliable data and drive revenue growth. If data is wrong, decisions are wrong. This role ensures that never happens.  ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **   You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:    Follow this  Willo link  (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.     Who You Are:    You are highly detail-oriented and process-driven.  You take ownership of problems and solve them without being handheld.  You move with urgency and do not let tasks sit idle.  You are highly experienced being the Hub Spot expert and troubleshooting issues independently.  You are not afraid to “get your hands dirty” fixing data and cleaning systems.  You communicate clearly and directly.  You can handle a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with strong personalities.  You do not make excuses, rather, you find solutions.    What You’ll Do:    Hub Spot Data Ownership & Accuracy   Own data cleanliness and accuracy inside Hub Spot across the entire sales pipeline  Identify and fix incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data  Ensure all sales data reflects reality and can be trusted for decision-making    Workflow & Automation Execution   Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Hub Spot workflows and automations  Ensure lead routing, deal movement, and task assignments function correctly  Reduce friction for Sales by simplifying and optimizing workflows    Sales Pipeline & Reporting Support   Maintain and support the integrity of the deal pipeline (lead → calls → close) Ensure accurate tracking of sales KPIs and performance metrics  Support and maintain integrations feeding into reporting systems (e.g., “Daily Dash”)   System Troubleshooting & Problem Solving   Diagnose issues across Hub Spot, integrations, and workflows  Work cross-functionally with Sales team members to identify root causes  Implement solutions quickly without waiting for direction    Process Documentation & Training   Build and maintain clear, step-by-step process documentation (“point-and-click” SOPs) Train Sales team members on correct system usage  Ensure new hires are properly set up and onboarded in Hub Spot and related tools    Quality Control & System Integrity   Ensure all workflows, automations, and data structures are functioning correctly  Continuously monitor for errors, inconsistencies, and breakdowns  Escalate issues quickly and proactively    Our Requirements Are Pretty Straightforward. To Qualify You Must:   2+ years experience managing a company’s Hub Spot instance for Sales  Strong understanding of sales pipelines and funnel stages  Proven experience building workflows and automations  Strong problem-solving ability and resourcefulness  High level of proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, data handling) Ability to work independently and execute without constant direction  Strong written and spoken English  Ability to work U. S. business hours consistently  Ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy  Bonus:  Hub Spot certifications  Experience with the following integrations: Zapier, Coefficient  Familiarity with sales tools such as Zoom Phone or similar systems  Exposure to AI tools or automation platforms    In Return, Here’s Our Promise to You:    At Crisp, we don’t just hire people: we build A-players.  Clear expectations. You will know exactly what success looks like.  High-impact work. Your work directly affects revenue decisions.  Fast-paced environment. Work moves quickly and decisively.  Growth opportunity. Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility.  Ownership culture. You are trusted to solve problems and execute.    Why Our Work Matters:    Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, not necessarily the best lawyers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in.  We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.  Our mission is to level the playing field, equipping these firms with the tools, strategies, and support they need to stand out and win.  We empower law firms to not only grow their businesses but also make a bigger impact — delivering better outcomes and driving positive change.  At Crisp, we’re here to ensure that the best law firms, no matter their size, have a fighting chance to lead, serve, and transform their communities.  By empowering our law firm clients to succeed, we’re not just building stronger businesses; we’re creating a ripple effect of positive change that impacts lives, families, and communities across the country.  About Crisp:    Crisp is an incredibly fast-moving, high-growth company (1470%+ growth in 3 years) with a laser focus on delivering the absolute best legal marketing and business coaching services on the market today.  Check out what we are about here:  We’re all about working hard and staying humble. In the spirit of humble bragging, here are some of our awards and accolades:  Crisp Founder and CEO Michael Mogill named EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2023 Named to Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 7-Years (2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017) Atlanta’s fastest-growing companies 9 years in a row (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) Recognized as Atlanta’s Best Places to Work  Creators and annual hosts of the Crisp Game Changers Summit , the largest and most ambitious law firm growth conference on Earth  Published the legal industry’s best-selling marketing book  Host of the most listened-to podcast in the legal industry  Featured in Forbes, The Wall Street Journal, Tech Crunch, Yahoo, and The Huffington Post    Why You Should Work Here:   You will work in a company where operations and systems are taken seriously  You will be part of building and improving core sales infrastructure  You will gain exposure to high-level sales operations and systems  You will be pushed to grow and perform at a high level    If you’re looking for a job that’s boring and easy, you won’t find that here. We put 110% into everything we do. Greatness is achieved through hard work, discipline, and sacrifice, and we’re determined to be great.  If you want to solve real problems, own systems, and operate at a high level — apply.

O desafio   Buscamos um  Senior Data Engineer  para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.  Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.  Aqui, você terá  alto nível de autonomia e ownership  , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.  O que você vai fazer:    Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a  arquitetura de dados da Volpi  , com foco em um modelo de  lakehouse  na AWS;   Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);  Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de  segurança, governança e compliance  ;   Lidar com  dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos  , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;   Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);  Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);  Criar a base para  produtos de dados futuros  , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;   Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.    O que esperamos de você:    Experiência sólida como  Data Engineer  , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);   Domínio de Python e SQL  para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;   Experiência prática com  AWS  , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;   Conhecimento e uso de  Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ;   Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;  Forte preocupação com  segurança da informação  , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;   Experiência em  ambientes de startup  , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;   Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;  Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;  Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.    Será considerado um diferencial:   Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;  Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);  Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;  Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.    Benefícios que oferecemos:   Modelo remoto prioritário  Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes) R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office  R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação  30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano  Day off no aniversário  Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind) Acesso ao Wework  Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Estágio de direito - home office
description:
Confira a vaga para Estágio de direito - home office em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O escritório  Ulisses Carneiro Advogados  ( especializado em  Direito Previdenciário (RGPS) , com sede em Brasília e atuação em todo o território nacional, está com vaga aberta para  Estágio em Direito  (6º ao 9º semestre), com atuação 100% home office  . Sobre o Escritório  Com mais de 17 anos de experiência  e 50 mil clientes atendidos em todo o Brasil  , o escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados se consolidou como referência em Direito Previdenciário.  Somos também pioneiros no uso de tecnologia na advocacia: contamos com o  ADV Space  , nosso próprio software jurídico integrado com inteligência artificial, criado para otimizar atendimentos e transformar a experiência do cliente.  Nosso fundador, Bruno Ulisses Carneiro, começou a programar em 1998, aos 14 anos, e desde então une Direito e tecnologia para criar soluções inovadoras. Além de advogado, Bruno é professor do  Instituto Professora Melissa Folmann  , onde já formou centenas de advogados e mentorou profissionais que hoje lideram seus próprios escritórios.  Aqui, o estágio não é apenas cumprir horas: é uma oportunidade de  aprender na prática  com quem já formou talentos e continua transformando a advocacia com inovação.  Detalhes da Vaga  Horário:  9h às 15h (6 horas diárias)  Bolsa:  R$ 1.200,00 + ajuda de custo para home office   Modelo:  100% remoto (aceitamos candidatos de qualquer localidade) Início:  imediato, após formalização do contrato pelo IEL    ✅ O que esperamos de você  Estar cursando entre o 6º e o 9º semestre de Direito  .   Ter  vivência prática em Direito Previdenciário  (estágio anterior, núcleo de prática ou projetos reais).   Boa comunicação escrita e/ou oral (recepção de clientes, análise de casos, auxílio em conversão de contratos).  Comprometimento, organização e vontade de crescer.    O que oferecemos  Atuação prática em casos reais  de Direito Previdenciário.   Contato direto com clientes via ADV Space.  Possibilidade de desenvolver tanto a parte  técnica (petições, análise de documentos) quanto a parte  comercial (conversão de contratos, relacionamento com clientes) .   Cultura de inovação, uso de tecnologia e espaço para crescimento.  Orientação direta com um escritório que já formou diversos profissionais hoje líderes no mercado.    Processo Seletivo  Formulário online  (Google Forms – necessário login com Gmail):    Prova escrita narrativa  (online).  Entrevista final  com o fundador.    A vaga ficará aberta até 20/05/2026 .  Os selecionados receberão comunicação oficial pelo e-mail     (verifique também sua caixa de spam).  Observações  O candidato não precisa ter OAB.  O contrato será formalizado pelo  IEL  (auxiliaremos no cadastro, se necessário).   O contato com o escritório deve ser feito  exclusivamente por e-mail  . Mensagens via Whats App ou ligações resultarão em desclassificação.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em garibaldi. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em itu. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Supplier quality coordinator
description:
Nova oportunidade para Supplier quality coordinator em taubaté. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.  Could you be the full-time Supplier Quality Coordinator in Taubaté we’re looking for?  Your future role   Take on a new challenge and apply your quality management expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside a collaborative and detail-oriented team of professionals.  You'll ensure the compliance of purchased products and parts delivered to Alstom facilities, making a significant impact on the quality and reliability of our operations. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (procurement, engineering, and manufacturing), manage the Incoming Inspectors and Serial Supplier Quality Engineers, and oversee supplier quality performance, among other responsibilities.  You’ll specifically take care of incoming inspection management and supplier nonconformity management, but also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and team development.  We’ll look to you for:  Collaborating with SPQD (Supplier Product and Quality Development) and Incoming Inspectors to ensure control plans are defined and registered in the ERP system   Ensuring inspection instructions and checklists are available and followed   Managing supplier nonconformities, including containment actions and root cause analysis   Leading and developing a team of SQ (Supplier Quality) engineers and inspectors   Preparing reports on supplier quality performance and improvement plans   Contributing to site quality continuous improvement programs   All about you   We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:  Bachelor’s degree in quality, engineering (mandatory)   Familiarity with supplier qualification standards (, ISO, ASME, IRIS, local standards)   Fluency in English, desireable Spanish   Experience managing supplier relationships and using SAP or similar systems   Knowledge of Quality Wall, Quality Basics, P-FMEA, and Control Plan management   Strong leadership and conflict management skills   Clear communication needed for the function  Analytical, detail-oriented, and process-focused mindset   Technical understanding in mechanical or electrical domains   Things you’ll enjoy   Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:  Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous daily routines   Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues   Contribute to innovative projects that redefine mobility   Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment   Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries   Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning programs   Progress towards leadership roles or technical specialisations   Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)   You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!  Important to note   As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
